metadata.description: Enterprise security for Cursor: skills, rules and subagents that review, design and build code against OWASP's LLM, Agentic and application-security standards, plus deterministic guardrail hooks.

plugins.name: secure-coding
plugins.description: Six security skills, an always-on security baseline rule, an infrastructure rule, and read-only security-reviewer and threat-modeler subagents.

plugins.name: secure-guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks that block credentials in prompts and MCP calls, deny reading secret files, block dangerous shell commands and ask before irreversible ones.
